tasks.title: Implement durable transport and cursors
criteria: Manual corrections survive restart; project/repository/branch/snapshot/causal/policy/source IDs are retained.
Transport cannot claim Task lifecycle or canonical publication outcomes; cache cleanup cannot erase durable events.

tasks.title: Implement bounded local event adapters
criteria: Human and agent commits are equivalent candidates; hooks only record bounded IDs and signal transport.
Existing hook managers are preserved; no live hook or service is installed by distribution.

tasks.title: Implement branch and snapshot checkpoints
criteria: Rebase, squash, force update, rename, deletion and branch switch recompute affected obligations.
Feature-branch knowledge does not become another branch current; assessment alone never advances reconciliation.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic preflight and coalescing
criteria: No relevant delta, due check or pending work yields zero model calls, Tasks, knowledge records or content rewrite.
Unknown classes hold or receive bounded assessment; cache/control timestamps do not cause full reanalysis.

tasks.title: Implement causal deduplication and stopping
criteria: Duplicate/retried/out-of-order deliveries produce one logical outcome.
A code repair still receives documentation/knowledge follow-through; derivative-only follow-up does not restart the repair.
Unchanged failures/output and selected limits stop expansion with the unresolved finding retained.

classification: Generic deterministic implementation candidate: approved plan/state-paths already select durable immutable deliveries, branch-bound snapshots and existing owner routes; no alternative architecture is requested. Confirm exact scope when assigning.

interfaces.event: Strict version1 envelope: event/causal/operation IDs; project/repository/root/branch; source snapshot and policy/source hashes; typed manual correction, commit or due-check; bounded payload/source references; no credentials or shell commands.
interfaces.queue: Exclusive immutable event publication plus exact digest replay; conflicting sameID rejected; append-only delivery receipts and compare-and-swap cursor; missing cache cannot erase events. Query/status are read-only.
interfaces.git: Selected executable and local repository identity, NUL-delimited bounded metadata; only branch/commit/diff/ancestry reads. No hooks installed, reset/checkout/stash/fetch/commit or external access. Preserve human/agent source neutrality.
interfaces.snapshots: Observed, assessed, integrated and reconciled checkpoints remain separate per selected branch. Rewritten ancestry/renames/deletions trigger typed obligations; assessment alone never advances reconciliation. Unavailable volume/root is unavailable, not deletion.
interfaces.preflight: Pure deterministic relevance/due/pending checks from exact inputs and existing classifier. Ignore known control/cache churn. No relevant work produces zero model/task/knowledge/rewrites. Unknown/mixed classes held or bounded assessment, not mutation.
interfaces.causality: Original operation ID plus branch/source/obligation type deduplicates duplicate/reordered delivery. Repair creates documentation/knowledge follow-through; derived-only event cannot re-enter repair. Repeated unchanged failures stop under finite selected limits.
interfaces.metrics: Read-only measures derived from events/outcomes; no competing lifecycle or mutable metric ledger.

verification_cases: Restart and deleted rebuildable cache preserve queued manual correction.
Exact replay idempotent; altered duplicate rejected; reordered inputs converge.
Rebase/squash/force-update/branch switch/rename/delete remain branch-bound and distinct from assessment.
Noop/irrelevant/cache-only checks have zero model/owner writes.
Repair follow-through does not recurse into duplicate repair.
Finite count/time/byte iteration bounds stop repeated unchanged work.
staging: Implement/test a complete candidate package in owned staging, then promote only reviewed source files together. Keep G1 frozen runtime closure untouched during native execution; no active scheduler/service/hook.
acceptance_gate: PHASE004 completion remains held until required PHASE003 native/confinement integration passes. Independent deterministic source work may proceed under the new broad user instruction.
preservation: Current state-paths contract is adequate; avoid editing it solely to satisfy target inventory. Original phase001 editions retained; no active-root/product adoption or Git publication.
